Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer agent failed to correctly identify the runtime of "Nosferatu the Vampyre" (1979) as being less than 2 hours. In Step 3, the Orchestrator instructed the WebSurfer to "cross-check the runtime of the highest-rated Isabelle Adjani feature films according to IMDB and identify which ones are less than 2 hours long." The WebSurfer clicked on the link for "Nosferatu the Vampyre" (which was the 4th item in the list shown in the screenshot), but the OCR output provided in the response only listed the title "Nosferatu the Vampyre" without extracting or reporting its runtime. Consequently, the agent could not verify if the film met the "less than 2 hours" criteria. This led to the Orchestrator incorrectly including "Nosferatu the Vampyre" in the final list of candidates to check for availability on Vudu, even though the film's runtime (approximately 148 minutes) is indeed less than 2 hours, but the agent failed to explicitly confirm this fact during the data gathering phase, relying instead on the Orchestrator's later assumption or incomplete data processing. More critically, the agent failed to extract the necessary data (runtime) for the film it clicked on, which was the specific instruction given. The error is a failure to extract and report the required data point (runtime) for the specific item it navigated to, leading to an incomplete dataset for the next step.
